name: Baluster
author: E. T. Carter
description: A stair banister's shadow thrown up a wall: a fan of dark bars radiates from an off-screen anchor below the corner, tapering and graded from broad-soft to knife-sharp. An implied lamp swings on a slow pendulum downstairs, so the whole fan pivots and the bars scissor between deeper dark and lit wedges.

params.label: Swing speed
params.effect: Rate of the implied lamp's pendulum arc that pivots and scissors the fan.

params.label: Bar width
params.effect: CSS-pixel base thickness of the banister bars before projective taper.

params.label: Fan spread
params.effect: How widely the fan of bars opens across the frame, from a tight sheaf to a full sweep.

params.label: Penumbra
params.effect: Strength of the soft-to-sharp blur gradient across the fan.
